content: Amoone na7ay Iyosyaasi Yihudan kawotida wode Sofoniyaasako yida Godaa qaalay haysa. Sofoniyaasi Kuusha na7aa; Kuushi Gadalla na7a; Gadalli Amaare na7a; Amaarey Hizqiyaasa na7aa.
Asenne mehee, salo kafotanne abba molota dhaysana. Iita asata shira yeggana; asa zare biitta bollafe dhaysana” yaagees Goday.
“Yihudaninne Yerusalaamen de7iya ubbaa seeranaw ta kushiya denthana. Ba7aale eeqa goyinneysatanne iya haggaaziya kahineta he bessaafe dhaysana.
Keetha bolla keyidi awas, ageenasinne xoolintotas goyinneyisata taani dhaysana. Godaa goyinnishenne iya sunthan caaqishe Moloka geetetiya eeqa sunthan caaqeyisata taani dhaysana.
Tana kaalo aggidi guye simmidaysata, tana koyboonaysatanne tana oychiboonayisata taani dhaysana” yaagees Goday.
Godaa gallasay matida gisho, Ubbaa Haariya Godaa sinthan si77i giite! Goday yarshuwa giigisis; qassi ba xeegida imathata geeshshis.
“Godaa yarshuwa gallas halaqata, kawa naytanne allaga biitta ma7o ma77ida ubbaa taani seerana.
He gallas allaga biitta asatada, eeqa goyinneysatanne banta godaa keethaa geellatethaninne cimon kuntheyisata taani seerana” yaagees Goday.
“He gallas Molo Pengiya baggara waasoy, katamaas nam7antho shaahuwan yeehonne zumata bolla gita dom7e girsi si7etana.
Hinteno, katamaas garsa baggan de7eysato, yeekite. Yan zal7iya ubbay dhayidosona; bira oykidaysati hayqi wuridosona.
He gallas taani xompe oythada Yerusalaame gidduwa koyana. Hirgi bayna wodhi uttidi banta wozanan, ‘Goday lo77oka iitaka’ geyisata taani seerana.
Enta shaloy bonqetana; enta keethay laaletana. Enti keethe keexana, shin he keethan dookona; woyne tokana, shin he woyniya uyokona” yaagees Goday.

content.text: He gallas mino olanchotika waaso goochana.
adussa gimbeta bolla ola moyzey punetana;
qooqeda tattafana gakanaw, enta bolla meto ehana.
enta biraynne enta worqay enta ashshena.
I sa7an de7iya ubbaa qoponna dhaysana;
biitta ubbay iya hanquwa taman meetetana” yaagees Goday.
